mapper.select:
with TEMP_INTERF_CSTP_TRADE as(SELECT distinct I.EXECID execid,
I.BUSINESSTYPE businesstype,
CASE WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '10' THEN I.UNDERLYINGSECURITYID WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '8' THEN I.UNDERLYINGSECURITYID ELSE I.SECURITYID END securityid, CASE WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '4' THEN I.SYMBOL WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '8' THEN I.UNDERLYINGSYMBOL ELSE NULL END symbol, CASE I.BUSINESSTYPE WHEN 'BOND' THEN DECODE(I.SIDE, '1', 'T01', '4', 'T02') WHEN 'REPO' THEN DECODE(I.SIDE, '1', '04', '4', '03') WHEN 'ISLD' THEN DECODE(I.SIDE, '1', '05', '4', '06') WHEN 'IRS' THEN DECODE(I.LEGSIDE1, '1', '02', 'B', '02', '4', '01') END side, I.LASTQTY lastqty, CASE I.BUSINESSTYPE WHEN 'BOND' THEN I.PRICE WHEN 'REPO' THEN I.PRICE*100 else I.PRICE END price,
I.DIRTYPRICE dirtyprice, I.YIELD2 underlyingyield2, I.TRADEDATE tradedate, I.ACCRUEDINTERESTAMT accruedinterestamt, I.ACCRUEDINTERESTTOTALAMT accruedinteresttotalamt, I.SETTLCURRAMT2 settlcurramt2, I.TRADELIMITDAYS tradelimitdays, I.CASHHOLDINGDAYS cashholdingdays, CASE WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '10' THEN I.SETTLCURRAMT WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '2' THEN I.LASTQTY ELSE I.TRADECASHAMT END tradecashamt, CASE WHEN I.MARKETINDICATOR = '2' THEN TO_DATE(I.STARTDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE TO_DATE(I.SETTLDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END settleDate,
I.SETTLCURRAMT as settlcurramt,
I.OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER acctNo
FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE I
left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET iqbd on I.EXECID = iqbd.EXECID left join IBU_QUOTE_CREP iqc on I.EXECID = iqc.EXECID where (iqbd.EXECID is not null or iqc.EXECID is not null)
and (iqbd.CREATE_USER = #{loginUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or iqbd.UPDATE_USER = #{loginUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or iqc.CREATE_USER = #{loginUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or iqc.UPDATE_USER = #{loginUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND I.BUSINESSTYPE = #{finprodType} )
SELECT LISTAGG(tempData.portfolioId, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY tempData.portfolioId) AS portfolioId, LISTAGG(tempData.portfolioName, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY tempData.portfolioId) AS portfolioName, tempData.execid, tempData.businesstype, tempData.securityid, tempData.symbol, tempData.side, tempData.lastqty, tempData.price, tempData.dirtyprice, tempData.underlyingyield2, tempData.tradedate, tempData.accruedinterestamt, tempData.accruedinteresttotalamt, tempData.tradecashamt, tempData.settlcurramt2, tempData.tradelimitdays, tempData.cashholdingdays, tempData.settleDate, tempData.settlcurramt, tempData.acctNo, tempData.matchStatus FROM (
SELECT distinct CASE WHEN TRD.TRADE_ID IS NULL THEN WADD.PORTFOLIO_ID ELSE TADD.PORTFOLIO_ID END portfolioId, CASE TRD.TRADE_ID WHEN NULL THEN WP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ELSE P.PORTFOLIO_NAME END portfolioName, I.execid, I.businesstype, I.securityid, I.symbol, I.side, I.lastqty, I.price, I.dirtyprice, I.underlyingyield2, I.tradedate, I.accruedinterestamt, I.accruedinteresttotalamt, I.tradecashamt, I.settlcurramt2, I.tradelimitdays, I.cashholdingdays, I.settleDate,
I.settlcurramt,
I.acctNo, CASE WHEN TRD.TRADE_ID IS NULL and WFL.TRADE_ID is null THEN '02' ELSE '01' END matchStatus FROM TEMP_INTERF_CSTP_TRADE I LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TRD ON TRD.F_TRADE_ID = I.EXECID AND TRD.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TRD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TADD ON TRD.TRADE_ID = TADD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO P ON TADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WFL ON WFL.F_TRADE_ID = I.EXECID AND WFL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND WFL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WADD ON WFL.TRADE_ID = WADD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO WP ON WP.PORTFOLIO_ID = WADD.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEM_CODE,ITEM_VALUE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST T WHERE T.DICT_CODE= 'PS')A ON I.side = A.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEM_CODE,ITEM_VALUE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST T WHERE T.DICT_CODE= 'TRADE_TYPE_CSTP')B ON i.businesstype = B.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEM_CODE,ITEM_VALUE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST T WHERE T.DICT_CODE= 'MATCH_STATUS')C ON (CASE WHEN TRD.TRADE_ID IS NULL and WFL.TRADE_ID is null THEN '02' ELSE '01' END) = B.ITEM_CODE
AND (WP.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR P.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )
AND I.MARKETINDICATOR =#{marketindicator}
AND I.SIDE IN
#{item}
AND I.SECURITYID = #{finprodId}
AND I.EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{execid},'%'))
AND (TRD.TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL OR WFL.TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL)
AND (TRD.TRADE_ID IS NULL AND WFL.TRADE_ID IS NULL)
AND 1=2
AND (TRADEDATE BETWEEN #{tradeDateBegin} AND #{tradeDateEnd})
and (p.portfolio_id like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or p.portfolio_name like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.execid like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.acctno like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.businesstype like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or b.item_value like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.securityid like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.symbol like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.side like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or a.item_value like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.lastqty like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.price like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.dirtyprice like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.underlyingyield2 like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or i.tradedate like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or I.accruedinterestamt like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or I.accruedinteresttotalamt like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or I.tradecashamt like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or I.settleDate like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or I.acctNo like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or CASE WHEN TRD.TRADE_ID IS NULL and WFL.TRADE_ID is null THEN '02' ELSE '01' END like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%' or c.item_value like '%'|| #{keywords}|| '%')
) tempData GROUP BY tempData.execid, tempData.businesstype, tempData.securityid, tempData.symbol, tempData.side, tempData.lastqty, tempData.price, tempData.dirtyprice, tempData.underlyingyield2, tempData.tradedate, tempData.accruedinterestamt, tempData.accruedinteresttotalamt, tempData.tradecashamt, tempData.settlcurramt2, tempData.tradelimitdays, tempData.cashholdingdays, tempData.settleDate, tempData.settlcurramt, tempData.acctNo, tempData.matchStatus order by tempData.matchStatus desc, tempData.tradedate desc

SELECT distinct EXECID id, EXECID text FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE
AND (EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT distinct EXECID code, EXECID name FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE
AND EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%'))

SELECT distinct SECURITYID code, SYMBOL name, SYMBOL shortName FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE
AND (SECURITYID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR SYMBOL LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))
